candidate.mark_source: DefiLlama Lighter unlock/protocol snapshots around the observation timestamp

why_capital_appears_to_be_arriving: Lighter already has material Robinhood-distributed order flow and now has an Arc integration/direct-deposit route, widening distribution.
Perpetual and RWA-perpetual utilization is large enough to represent actual secondary trading rather than an issuance-only narrative.
Protocol revenue has a direct LIT value-capture path through treasury buybacks.
incentive_discount: Robinhood Chain transactions remain contaminated by a 90-day gas-rebate program scheduled to end on 2026-09-29, so chain-level user/transaction growth is not treated as fully discretionary.
LIT ecosystem reserves include a Robinhood community allocation and future growth/points capacity, so holder growth and staking are not treated as clean organic-demand evidence.
Current LIT price strength occurred while Binance LIT perpetual open interest declined, indicating that some of the move is short covering rather than fresh long capital.
rwa_distinction: Lighter's approximately $257.8M of 24-hour RWA-perpetual volume is genuine derivative secondary trading and usage, but it is synthetic/perpetual notional. It is not tokenized-equity issuance/AUM, direct stock ownership, or measured collateral utilization.

leadership_and_wallet_quality.wallet_evidence: A reported accumulator withdrew roughly 208.6K additional LIT after earlier withdrawals, bringing its observed accumulation near 979K LIT; however, the reporting explicitly described multiple wallets as moving in sync. Funding/beneficial-owner independence and historical selective profitability were not established, so this does not satisfy the selective-wallet convergence requirement.

structural_gate.contract_checks: Automated contract screening reports verified/open source, non-mintable, non-pausable, no blacklist and no honeypot flag.
structural_gate.holder_attribution: Incomplete; major addresses may include protocol/staking/locked allocations but this run did not independently attribute enough of the top-holder set to clear concentration risk for a new entry.
structural_gate.unlock_risk: Insider vesting begins around 2026-12-29 at roughly 3.19M LIT per week under the current schedule, a material future dilution overhang.
structural_gate.ecosystem_reserve_risk: Reserve allocation can fund future growth initiatives/points/partnerships, creating ongoing incentive-contamination risk.

paper_portfolio.existing_positions_decision: HOLD existing positions; no add/trim/sell signal crossed the framework threshold in this run. ZEC remains above the original 7.5% sizing target because of appreciation, not a new purchase, and no thesis/structural exit trigger fired.

entry_confirmation_required: A new independently funded, historically selective wallet cohort; or measurable Arc-sourced deposits/stablecoin/volume plus persistence after Robinhood's gas rebate expires, while Lighter usage/revenue-funded buybacks remain elevated. A consolidation/retest would be preferable to chasing the current short-covering-assisted token move.
